layout_admission: Each executable hash selects exactly its verified database schema: build 25803875 with 73, build 26320224 with 75. Crossed pairs, unrecognized executables and unverified database versions remain rejected. Database migration remains owned by the game.
tests_scope: Nine local SQLite regressions passed, including both supported layouts, three-slot updates, unrelated world/unknown-bit retention, WAL-only backup data, native case/path behavior, rejected triggers, stale/replaced/read-only/corrupt databases and no-op writes. Both crossed build/schema pairs and unknown versions 74/76 are rejected before backup or mutation. Separate real native world copies passed public stopped-instance read/write, exact executable gates, committed reload and pre-change backup readback. All original DB/WAL bytes stayed unchanged. Backups omit only the reconstructable SCUM.db-shm index and retain the database, WAL and unrelated sidecars. No user database or client combat was used.
